title: Defend a Position
condition: Given a squad, an assigned sector, and an enemy force capable of attacking the position.
standard: Construct the position in accordance with the assigned sector, complete priorities of work, maintain 360-degree observation, and be prepared to repel an attack.
steps: Construct primary fighting position(s) sited to cover the assigned sector.
Maintain observation to the front, flank, and rear of the position.
Respond to fire commands and displace to alternate or supplementary positions on order.
